# Fighting Force Recharged 0.0.133

[![Support on Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support_on_Ko--fi-FF5E5B?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/utkiduck)

![Fighting Force Recharged 0.0.133 release poster](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/releases/download/v0.0.133/FightingForceRecharged-0.0.133-Poster.png)

An unofficial modernization patch for the original Windows version of
**Fighting Force (1997)**. This update repairs Train's sliding doors and
improves first-person visibility, heavy-weapon aiming and local co-op.

**Car Park camera update.** The first-person camera stays at head height
beside the sloped building facade and above fallen gates. If you already
installed 0.0.133, download the updated Windows ZIP and run setup again.

## New in this version

- **Train doors** animate at all three carriage joins in the free cameras.
  Walk through the open doorway. Once players and active enemies are clear,
  the door closes and blocks return at the visible panel. Later enemy waves
  can reopen it from the previous carriage, with sound following the
  animation.
- **First-person scenery** stays visible when the camera is close to walls,
  partitions and doors. The Car Park facade and entrance hall receive
  specific fixes. Low animations give the camera more floor clearance, and
  elevator floor surfaces are clipped at the near plane.
- **Heavy-weapon aiming** adds a laser for the heavy gun and a direction
  reticle for the bazooka. The character turns with the first-person view
  while carrying the bazooka, shotgun or rifle. Shots and rockets follow
  the original firing rules.
- **Target focus and item controls** give middle mouse and R3 a dedicated
  lock/release action without a camera snap when no target is available.
  Throw/Drop is the only manual item release in either Separate Pickup
  mode. Heavy throw-only items disable kicks, and detaching scenery or
  performing the spin attack requires empty hands.
- **Co-op controller recovery** keeps the connected player in their role.
  A vacant automatic assignment can accept a controller from a free slot.
  Losing both pads pauses play. With two automatic assignments, press
  **A for Player 1** or **X for Player 2** on the first returning pad.
  Start remains available after reconnecting, and the surviving player can
  still lock onto enemies.
- **Cleaner pause and Options menus** keep the scene behind the Move List
  and hide the gameplay HUD while paused. A lone survivor goes straight to
  their own Move List and back to pause. The Options title has room above
  the settings, and **Friendly Fire** can be changed in Options or during
  cooperative pause.

## Default controls

| Action | Keyboard and mouse | Xbox / XInput |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Throw or drop | Q | LB |
| Backfist or enemy grab | E | B |
| Block, when enabled | Hold R | Hold LT |
| Pick up | F | RB |
| Run | Hold Shift | Hold RT |
| Punch or fire a held firearm | Left mouse | X |
| Lock or release target | Middle mouse | R3 |
| Toggle first-person view | Tab | L3 |

Unchanged older Q/R defaults migrate together. Customized bindings are kept.
The Move List and pickup prompts show the applied bindings.

## Install or update

1. Extract **FightingForceRecharged-0.0.133-Windows.zip**.
2. Close the game and run **FightingForceSetup.exe**.
3. Choose **Add fix to existing game folder** and select the folder containing
   **fforce.exe**, or choose **Install game from original disc**.
4. Start **fforce.exe** from the installed game folder.

Setup preserves existing settings, campaign saves and original files. Requires
**Windows 10/11 x64** and a supported **English PC retail or reviewed English
RIP** copy. The retail edition needs its mounted disc. The reviewed RIP can
run from its folder, with original mounted audio media supplying CD music.
Setup includes compatibility files and reviewed dependencies. You supply the
game data.

## Validation and limits

Deterministic tests cover Train door transitions and sound dispatch,
first-person rendering and weapons, cooperative reconnects, pause and the
Move List. Full live coverage of the updated Train door audio and extended
two-controller play is pending. Free orbit, first-person view, dynamic split
screen and interpolated rendering remain experimental.

**release.json** records the source revision and artifact hashes.
**SHA256SUMS.txt** lists the download checksums. **Source.zip** contains
project source. The installer and wrapper are unsigned.

See the [quick start](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/blob/v0.0.133/docs/QUICKSTART.md),
[controls and Move List](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/blob/v0.0.133/docs/CONTROLS.md)
and [validation scope](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/blob/v0.0.133/docs/VALIDATION.md).
